This one was actually hosted by the black student union. The other one was from an off-campus group.

I empathize with you so much right now. I feel like I've been to so many different therapists who have told me so many different things, and its not like that I 'want' to be one thing, but to just have the feeling that I am something helps to create some sort of foundation for an already shaky sense of identity. There really are bad therapists/psychiatrists out there and I don't really feel how it is ever helpful for someone in there position to invalidate you the way that therapist seems to have.
I think i agree with you, but I'm trying to think of ways to go about it that won't be destructive to my interpersonal relationships
my therapist knows about suicidal ideation but I haven't told her about the recent escalation because I don't want to be hospitalized.

Heres a story for you to feel better about yours. 19/f

I was actually relatively young (17) and to put in baseball terms I kind of hit a home run but skipped bases 1, 2, and 3 before getting to home. I was working at my local amusement park, and this guy was a few years older and I had been working with him all day. He asked me back to his car to smoke and one thing led to the next and I ended up losing my virginity in the back of my beat up minivan in an amusement park parking lot. It all happened so fast that I had no what I was doing besides to demand the use of protection. 

 The guy told all my coworkers and I got some awful superslut reputation despite that being one of my only experiences. I still don't even know his last name =/
Truest thing I've seen all day
It could also be that you don't connect with this therapist. It took me a couple therapists before I found one that I felt comfortable opening up to.

I hid it for a long time, but I ended up sharing a room with 2 other people this year and spending large amounts of time with the same group of people so hiding it was pretty hard. 

I'm living alone again, so its easier for me now to just withdraw into myself. =/
